children: DELHI HIGH COURT PASSED AN ORDER DATED 31 AUGUST FOR CERTAIN APPLICATIONS FILED BY DAIICHI SANKYO AGAINST, INTER ALIA, FORTIS
COURT HAS NOT IMPOSED ANY LIABILITY, PENALTY OR FINE ON  IHH OR FORTIS
COURT DIRECTED APPOINTMENT OF FORENSIC AUDITOR
COMPANY IS REVIEWING ORDER IN DETAIL IN CONSULTATION WITH ITS LEGAL COUNSELS
ORDER INCLUDES DIRECTIONS TO EXAMINE TRANSACTION ON ACQUISITION OF CONTROLLING STAKE IN FORTIS BY IHH VIA NORTHERN TK VENTURE PTE
